d: Deputies chase homicide suspects into a swamp, and stop teens in a high-speed pursuit through Ocala.

st: The Real Life Monster: Aileen Wuornos
d: In 1989, Detectives Brian Jarvis and David Taylor race to solve a string of murders targeting middle-aged men along Florida highways.
When 5-year-old Tamra Keepness goes missing from her home, an entire city rallies to find "everyone's baby." Then, suspicion falls on her grieving family.
In Part 2, the police and Indigenous community continue the search for 5-year-old Tamra Keepness. A mysterious online tip raises hopes.

Chelsea is a young mother with a vibrant personality, but the loss of a family member sends her into a deep depression. Her distraught mother believes two individuals she meets on a psychiatric ward are behind her sudden disappearance.
When a small-town bank gets a note saying a couple has been kidnapped, the FBI races to find them.
Austrian police and the FBI hunt a killer strangling women with their bras — until he vanishes.
A journalist reports on his own murders, evades police across continents, and plots again.
A bomb threat at a casino ends in an explosion, leading the FBI to a surprising suspect.

st: Who The Hell Did I Marry?
d: When love turns to suspicion, Amber enlists her husband's ex-wife, Athena, to uncover his secrets.
Amber and Athena start a podcast about Brandon. More women emerge and new secrets are revealed.
Brandon's new girlfriend heeds Athena's warnings and breaks up with him, putting her life in danger.
After Wade Wilson leaves his date at a bar, a dead body is found, and a hunt for a killer begins.
Wade Wilson's shocking murder trial draws millions, as his girlfriend learns she fell for a monster.
Detectives uncover a shocking murder-for-hire plot targeting a beloved firefighter.
Police investigating a brutal double-homicide learn the prime suspect appears to be a grandmother.
When a religious woman goes missing, her Christian family begins to question her husband's devotion.
A bomb threat at a casino ends in an explosion, leading the FBI to a surprising suspect.
In 2003, a deadly bank robbery went cold-until new DNA led to a shocking breakthrough.
The FBI is called in to help investigate the mysterious shooting of two girls in rural Oklahoma.
The disappearance of an Oklahoma woman offers new leads in the shooting deaths of two young girls.
An FBI undercover sting on corrupt New Orleans police turns deadly when one dirty cop orders a hit.
The FBI joins forces with the state police to infiltrate, disrupt, and dismantle MS-13 in Boston.
